hero.title: Building Your Vision, One Foundation at a Time
hero.subtitle: From renovations and plastering to roofing, electrical, plumbing and more — PCC delivers quality, reliable construction services across all provinces of South Africa.

home.aboutPreview: PCC – Philip Chauke Construction is a trusted building and renovation contractor, delivering quality workmanship across all provinces of South Africa — from small repairs to complete new builds.

whyChooseUs.title: On-Time Delivery
whyChooseUs.text: Tight scheduling and solid project management keep every build on track, every time.

whyChooseUs.title: Quality First
whyChooseUs.text: We use premium materials and strict workmanship standards, so results last for decades.

whyChooseUs.title: Transparent Pricing
whyChooseUs.text: Clear quotes with no hidden costs — you always know exactly where your money goes.

body: PCC – Philip Chauke Construction is a building and renovation contractor serving clients in every province of South Africa. From new builds to renovations and repairs, we deliver quality workmanship on every project, big or small.
We take on the full scope of a build — planning, structural work, finishes, and handover — so you have one accountable team from start to finish.
With a focus on honest pricing, reliable timelines and work that lasts, we deliver results our clients can trust.

services.title: Renovations
services.description: Full-home and section renovations: updates, extensions and modernisations that bring your space back to life.

services.title: Plastering
services.description: Internal and external plastering and wall finishing for surfaces that are smooth, level and durable.

services.title: Fisca Boards
services.description: Installation and fitting of Fisca (fibre-cement) boards for walls, ceilings and roofing.

services.title: Electrical
services.description: Complete electrical installations, repairs and maintenance for homes and businesses.

services.title: Plumbing
services.description: Plumbing installations, repairs and maintenance — from leaks and taps to full bathroom plumbing.

services.title: House Wiring
services.description: Professional house wiring and rewiring for new builds, renovations and older properties.

services.title: House Plans
services.description: Drafting and design of house plans, extensions and alteration drawings for your project.

services.title: Roofing
services.description: Roof installation, repairs and replacements that keep your home safe and weatherproof.

services.title: Ceiling
services.description: Ceiling installation and repair, including drywall, fibre-cement and suspended ceilings.

services.title: Tile Fitting
services.description: Tile installation and fitting for floors, walls and bathrooms with clean, lasting finishes.
